checks.name: text original preview loading

checks.name: upload transfer and save feedback

checks.name: file version list loading

isolated_probe_runner.note: Probe success confirms observations; one probe deliberately reproduces a product FAIL, so this is not five product PASS results

limitations: No production uploads, point awards or model generation
Text preview only; all Office/PDF/media formats not retested
This is a loading-feedback audit, not full business or concurrency acceptance
